profile: New user-facing frontend without supplied design assets
prompt: Build a new administration frontend from a broad product request. No UI design or brand assets were supplied.
expected_actions: classify the UI impact as material and select co-design unless the user chooses another safe profile
discover target users, tasks, product constraints, available assets, platform and viewport needs before production code
offer a repository-backed recommended design direction and meaningful alternatives instead of asking for abstract style vocabulary
model primary, loading, empty, partial, error, permission, destructive, recovery, responsive, keyboard, focus, and accessibility states
choose the lightest useful design artifact and record UX Ready approval before production implementation
forbidden_actions: start production UI implementation before UX Ready
force Figma or a high-fidelity prototype without a demonstrated need
invent product features, information architecture, or workflows to make the design look richer
treat one happy-path mockup as an implementation-ready UX contract
